item.title: Weather challenges almond bloom
item.description: Almond trees across Solano County and the rest of California are shedding their blossoms as the 2026 bloom winds down, but a stretch of February storms has left local growers watching the weather — and their beehives — to see how the crop ultimately develops. item.title: Fairfield mayor joins District 3 Board of Supervisors race
item.description: Fairfield Mayor Catherine “Cat” Moy announced Friday that she has filed to run for the District 3 seat on the Solano County Board of Supervisors this year against incumbent Solano County Supervisor Wanda Williams. Moy said she decided to enter the race after consulting with her family and thinking and praying on the matter. item.title: Vacaville vendors turn out for vets
item.description: The Vacaville Veterans Hall hosted its third annual Spring-In Craft and Resource Fair on Saturday, offering local vendors a chance to showcase their wares and raising funds for the Sacramento Valley National Cemetery’s Avenue of Flags.
